Thanks Evelyn — quick commercial read: OptiMed is a greenfield expansion opportunity, likely $650k ARR if pilot converts. They asked for a one-year reduced indemnity cap and the data residency carveouts for a subset of projects. As a deal sweetener I'm willing to offer a 25% first-year discount and commit to a 12-month pilot pricing, contingent on compliance sign-off.

However, the indemnity and residency asks are material. If legal recommends we can't accept the lowered indemnity we could instead: 1) offer a 12% discount (net present concession) and 2) include a scoped addendum that limits residency exceptions to specific named projects with explicit data classification, logging, and audit rights.

Attaching a proposed mutual action plan and a redline of the SOW showing the carveouts. Would request executive clearance to approve the 12% concession now and authority to grant limited residency exceptions under appendix A after security sign-off.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T08:40:00Z
Subject: RE: Quick follow-up: Redwood pilot & compliance questionnaire — preliminary compliance notes

Team — reviewed the questionnaire and SOW redline. High-level flags:
- OptiMed's SOW indicates use cases that process clinical diagnostics and patient-derived signals. That elevates privacy and possible export-control considerations, depending on endpoints and data flows.
- Questionnaire shows use of third-party partners in APAC and EU; need subprocessor disclosures and data movement diagrams.
- No explicit mention of controlled cryptography exports, but if they push for on-prem device integrations with embedded encryption we will need legal/exports to vet.

Recommendations:
1) Do not approve a reduced indemnity cap at this time. Instead, condition any indemnity change on completed KYC + SOC2 evidence + a signed addendum limiting scope to non-PHI processed data.
2) Approve a commercial concession up to 12% immediately (Ben) to keep momentum, but require a compliance holdback: residency exceptions allowed only after security review and an export-control checklist is cleared.
3) I will open a formal export-control intake with Legal and Security. Suggest we request the following from OptiMed ASAP: a) list of countries involved in processing, b) data classification for each project, c) confirmation if any models or integrations will involve encryption modules requiring export licenses.

If Legal confirms no export license required and KYC/SOC2 are satisfactory, we can move to finalize with a scoped addendum. Looping Marissa for rollout/CS planning if we proceed.

— Karthik
Senior Counsel, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-12-15T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Deal desk escalation: export-control & nonstandard terms for OptiMed — Executive decision

Team — after reviewing the commercial impact and Karthik's compliance concerns, I am approving the following exception path for OptiMed:

1) Commercial concession: approve a 12% first-year discount (applies to pilot conversion), Finance to apply via one-time credit.
2) Residency exception: limited, project-specific residency carveouts may be granted only after Security's checklist is complete and sign-off is recorded on the addendum. Appendix A must enumerate projects, data classifications, and retention windows.
3) Indemnity: we will not accept a material reduction to indemnity caps. We will accept narrowly scoped liability language for specified non-regulated workloads only.

Conditions: OptiMed must provide completed KYC, SOC2 report (most recent), a completed export-control questionnaire (we have the draft but need full responses), and explicit confirmation whether any deployed encryption modules require export licensing. No residency exception goes live without Security sign-off.

Marissa — once the paperwork is complete please prepare an onboarding checklist and a 90-day monitoring plan. Ben — you can inform Raj of the approved 12% concession and the conditional nature of residency/indemnity exceptions; please use the MAP and attach the addendum template.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
